OpenMSI v1.5.0.0 | The Windows Installer Painkiller

Description:
  This tool is useful for creating Windows Installers (*.msi) using declarative YAML files.

Usage:
  openmsi [command] [options]

Options:
  -v, --verbose   Show detailed output
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  init <template>  Initializes a new OpenMSI project for you so you can immediately generate your Windows Installer (*.msi).
  
                   It usually creates a msi-package.yaml file and \msi-package directory with dialogs YAMLs and assets.
  
                   Did something different and awesome? Share your template on https://openmsi.dev/templates.
  
                   You can initialize a package project referencing a URL or an embedded template.
  
                   Available embedded template options:
                   - NoUI
                   - Welcome
                   - Welcome_Browse (Default)
                   - Welcome_Config
                   - Welcome_LicenseAgreement
                   - Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Browse
                   - Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Config
                   - Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Config_Browse
  
                   Usage examples:
  
                   openmsi init Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Browse
  
                   openmsi init https://openmsi.dev/downloads/templates/welcome-browse.7z
  preview <file>   Previews the specified MSI dialog.
  
                   Usage example:
  
                   openmsi preview WelcomeDlg --arg "MyArg1=value1"
  build <file>     Builds a Windows Installer (*.msi) file from an OpenMSI project.
  
                   Usage example:
  
                   openmsi build
  
                   openmsi build msi-package.yaml
  license          Activates an OpenMSI installation or checks the details of the current license. 
  
                   Usage example:
  
                   openmsi license --org-id <your organization Ide
[truncated]

Description:
  Initializes a new OpenMSI project for you so you can immediately generate your Windows Installer (*.msi).
  
  It usually creates a msi-package.yaml file and \msi-package directory with dialogs YAMLs and assets.
  
  Did something different and awesome? Share your template on https://openmsi.dev/templates.
  
  You can initialize a package project referencing a URL or an embedded template.
  
  Available embedded template options:
  - NoUI
  - Welcome
  - Welcome_Browse (Default)
  - Welcome_Config
  - Welcome_LicenseAgreement
  - Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Browse
  - Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Config
  - Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Config_Browse
  
  Usage examples:

Usage:
  openmsi init [<template>] [options]

Arguments:
  <template>  The template name or URL to be used in initialization. For complete list of embedded templates run `openmsi init --help`. Default 'Welcome_Browse'.

Options:
  -a, --arg, --argument <argument>  Initialization argument(s) requested by template. E.g.: --arg "Product Name=DemoApp" --arg "version=1.2.3"
  --overwrite                       Overwrite files that already exists.
  -?, -h, --help                    Show help and usage information
